source_name: AmCham Bulgaria news (SEE cluster chamber coverage)
why_relevant: Because the Mastercard MK cluster is run out of Bulgaria, the Bulgarian AmCham carried the Skopje-office-opening and SEE general-manager announcement. Cluster-parent-country chambers are a systematic indirect channel for MK-scoped scheme news.

source_name: Diebold Nixdorf leadership and newsroom
why_relevant: Core ATM/self-service vendor to MK banks; the corporate leadership and news pages are the only authoritative vendor-issued record of EMEA/Balkans org structure, though country-level MK detail was not found in this run.

source_name: ATM Marketplace
why_relevant: Trade press covering ATM/self-service vendors (Diebold Nixdorf, NCR Atleos/Voyix) including corporate restructurings such as the NCR split; the reliable channel for vendor org changes that later cascade into Balkans country teams serving MK banks.

source_name: Wise Newsroom (CEU / UKI regional editions)
why_relevant: Wise publishes regional appointment releases (e.g. EMEA expansion leadership for Wise Platform) in per-region newsroom editions including a Central Europe edition; the channel where any MK/Balkans market lead would first be named.

source_name: Revolut newsroom and careers (regional editions)
why_relevant: Revolut announces country/regional recruitment drives and market entries through localized newsroom editions; a Bulgarian/regional edition post announcing an MK hiring push would be the earliest signal of MK market entry.

source_name: Western Union Macedonia market site
why_relevant: Confirms WU's active MK market presence and names local agent/bank partners; the partner and country-page structure is the entry point for identifying who manages the MK corridor, given no MK-specific WU appointment news was found.

source_name: Temenos global offices and partner directory
why_relevant: Core-banking vendor whose MK footprint runs through partners/implementers rather than a country office; the offices and partner directory pages reveal which regional entity and which SI partner owns MK accounts, an indirect route to the relevant hires.

source_name: Vrabotuvanje.com.mk — Banking positions job search
why_relevant: Largest MK job portal (claims 500k+ unique visitors/month, top-15 MK websites). Bank and PSP vacancies are posted here first; the 'Banking' position filter yields a clean, dated feed of role titles (operational risk specialist, credit portfolio management, internal audit) that are direct weak signals of unit build-out and reorganisation. Also carries an 'Економија, Финансии и Сметководство' category and employer-branded career pages (NLB, ProCredit, Kapital Banka).

source_name: Bankarstvo.mk — Кариера (bank vacancy aggregator)
why_relevant: HIGHEST-VALUE UNEXPECTED FIND for this cell. A Macedonian banking trade site that republishes, as individual dated articles, the vacancy announcements of virtually every MK bank and several PSP/fintechs — Komercijalna, NLB, Stopanska (incl. Bitola), Sparkasse, Halkbank, Silk Road Bank, Centralna Kooperativna Banka, CaSys, Iute Macedonia. This is a pre-aggregated, sector-filtered vacancy stream that removes the need to crawl every bank career page, and it doubles as an actor map of the MK banking/PSP employer universe.

source_name: Агенција за вработување на РСМ (AVRSM) — e-Работа тековни огласи
why_relevant: The statutory public employment service vacancy register. Employers, including banks, have legal reporting duties to AVRSM, so this is the closest thing to a mandatory-disclosure vacancy feed in MK. Useful as a completeness check against commercial boards and for counting hiring volume by sector/occupation code — a capacity indicator rather than a single-ad signal.

source_name: Pazar3.mk — Работа и бизнис / Работа (Skopje, IT)
why_relevant: Largest MK classifieds site (400k+ active ads) with a large jobs vertical, including a dedicated IT section. Lower-prestige channel than Vrabotuvanje for senior bank roles, but it captures outsourced/contract, call-centre, POS-field-service, cash-handling and agency-mediated hiring that banks and PSPs push through intermediaries — exactly the operational-capacity layer that never reaches press releases.

source_name: MojaPlata.mk — MK salary survey by position and sector
why_relevant: Not a vacancy board but a salary-benchmark survey (~20,000 respondents, run in partnership with Vrabotuvanje). Gives pay levels by position and by sector including financial/service activities, plus gender split and average age per profession. Converts raw vacancy counts into cost-of-capacity estimates and flags where a bank must pay above market to staff a scarce skill (AML, core-banking, fraud) — a second-order signal of programme urgency.

source_name: Apliciraj.mk — job application portal
why_relevant: Carries MK financial-sector vacancies not always mirrored elsewhere; an observed listing is 'Одговорно лице за спречување на перење пари и финансирање тероризам' at NLB Фондови АД — i.e. it reaches non-bank financial subsidiaries (fund management, leasing, insurance-adjacent) that sit inside banking groups and are a blind spot for bank-only monitoring.

source_name: Vraboti.se — job board (Skopje region filter)
why_relevant: Additional MK vacancy aggregator with a region query parameter; adds recall for mid-tier employers and PSP/IT vendors. Value is completeness of the vacancy universe rather than unique signal.

source_name: Fakulteti.mk — Job (оглас) section
why_relevant: Education/careers portal that publishes individual vacancy announcements from payments-infrastructure employers — observed ads for КаСис АД Скопје (systems engineers) and Asseco South Eastern Europe Macedonia (software developers for mobile payment solutions). These are the processor/vendor-side hiring signals that bank-only monitoring misses and that reveal which payment platforms are being built or migrated.

source_name: Stopanska Banka AD Skopje — Кариера во СБ / vacancy news
why_relevant: Primary-issuer career page for one of MK's largest banks (NBG/OTP group). Bank career pages are the authoritative version of an ad — full role description, department name, reporting line — where boards often carry only a truncated version. Observed a specific AML/CTF associate posting ('Соработник за спречување на перење пари и финансирање на тероризам') published in the bank's own news feed.

source_name: LinkedIn — MK bank/PSP company pages and job posts
why_relevant: MK banks post vacancy announcements in Macedonian on their LinkedIn company pages (observed: Komercijalna Banka AD posting an 'ОГЛАС ЗА ВРАБОТУВАЊЕ' for two specialists), and LinkedIn is the only practical channel for leadership moves — title changes, new heads of payments/compliance, departures — which no MK job board captures. KIBS AD (the interbank payment-system operator owned by 10 MK banks) maintains a page here.

source_name: ФЕИТ (Faculty of Electrical Engineering & IT, UKIM) — Вработувања
why_relevant: The main MK engineering faculty's employment/internship page — the recruiting channel for core-banking developers, payment-systems and fraud/data engineers. Postings here from banks, CaSys, KIBS or Asseco/Payten indicate technical programme staffing (ISO 20022 migration, instant-payments integration, digital channels) that is invisible on generalist boards.

source_name: ESI.mk — Employment Services International (recruitment agency)
why_relevant: MK recruitment/staffing intermediary advertising jobs in Macedonia and abroad. Agency-mediated searches are how banks fill sensitive or senior roles without naming themselves; a blind 'leading financial institution seeks Head of Compliance' ad is still a datable capacity signal and sometimes de-anonymisable from the role description.

source_name: Ahrefs competitor profiles for MK job-board domains
why_relevant: Pure pointer/discovery utility: the competitor lists for vrabotuvanje.com.mk, kariera.mk, apliciraj.mk and av.gov.mk enumerate the full MK job-board long tail by traffic, which is the cheapest way to close recall gaps in this cell and to detect a new board entering the market. Not a content source.

source_name: NLB Banka Skopje — LinkedIn company page (posts / People / Jobs tabs)
why_relevant: Third-largest MK bank; page publishes internal appointment congratulations, farewell/thank-you posts for departing managers (an observed example post thanks a departing colleague in Macedonian), and the People tab exposes headcount and function-mix drift over time.

source_name: TTK Banka AD Skopje — LinkedIn company page
why_relevant: Mid-size MK bank; LinkedIn is its main channel for staff-level announcements and vacancies that never reach the press.

source_name: UNIBanka AD Skopje — LinkedIn company page
why_relevant: UNIBanka posts vacancies and organisational news; cross-checkable against bankarstvo.mk vacancy reposts.

source_name: ProCredit Bank Macedonia — LinkedIn company page
why_relevant: Group-owned bank with an active employer-brand LinkedIn practice (trainee programmes, internal promotions) — good early signal of hiring waves and function build-out.

source_name: Capital Bank AD Skopje — LinkedIn company page
why_relevant: Small bank where LinkedIn is likely the only public record of mid-level org changes; headcount on the People tab is small enough that changes are individually visible.

source_name: Post Bank AD Skopje (Пошт​енска банка) — LinkedIn company page
why_relevant: Newer entrant to the MK banking market; LinkedIn People/Jobs tabs are the fastest visible indicator of a de-novo bank staffing up (payments, risk, IT functions).
